sources.name: Our model
sources.note: Match odds from blended market odds, player shares from FPL xG and xA, plus clean sheets, defensive contribution and bonus.

sources.name: elevenify
sources.note: elevenify publishes no points, so this is our points formula run on elevenify's team goals, clean-sheet chances and player goal and assist rates.

sources.name: Solio Analytics
sources.note: Solio's public projected points for the gameweek. It publishes only its top players, so some rows are blank.

sources.name: Fantasy Football Pundit
sources.note: Fantasy Football Pundit's start-weighted projected points for the gameweek.

sources.name: FPL
sources.note: FPL's own expected points (ep_next). Form-based and erratic, so it is shown but left out of the average.
